knownCaveats.title: Ablation delta column is relative to raw-only, not FULL
knownCaveats.detail: `phase8_ablation_decomposed.csv.delta_pr_auc` subtracts each variant from the raw-only row (the last row), so its sign and magnitude are not the effect of removing a feature from FULL. The app recomputes `variant.pr_auc - FULL.pr_auc` for display. Use that recomputation, not the source column.

knownCaveats.title: Weekly boundary week straddles the train/test cut
knownCaveats.detail: The week ending 2020-06-21 contains both train and test transactions because the split boundary is 12:13:37 on that Sunday. Weekly sums reconcile to 1,852,394 / 9,651, but train/test weekly means are not exact split means. The last week (2021-01-03) is a partial zero-fraud edge week and is excluded from trend means.

knownCaveats.title: The source calls the card fraud-rate distribution bimodal; it is zero-inflated
knownCaveats.detail: 23 of 999 cards have no fraud, 885 have a partial rate, and 91 have a 100% rate. The histogram has mass only in the first and last bins because fraud is card-clustered; it is not a symmetric two-peak distribution. The app labels it zero-inflated.

knownCaveats.title: The leakage demo reports equal naive and causal correlations
knownCaveats.detail: The ledger says full-data target encoding inflates signal, but the recorded Spearman correlations are both 0.048 at displayed precision. The notebook output does not demonstrate inflation. The app records this as audit note AN-01 rather than a confirmed result.

knownCaveats.title: Merchant-to-category is not deterministic
knownCaveats.detail: The ledger says merchant→category is deterministic, but the evidence records `max cats/merchant=2`. The app keeps the collinearity caution but does not repeat the deterministic claim.

knownCaveats.title: ZIP3 Cramér's V is not comparable to category V
knownCaveats.detail: The ZIP3 association (V=0.148) is estimated over 532 levels, while category (V=0.067) has 14 levels. The larger V partly reflects granularity and should not be read as a stronger substantive effect without adjustment.

knownCaveats.title: The notebook reports 45 tables; the workspace contains 46
knownCaveats.detail: The extra table is the report `figure_index.csv` (or a run-metadata table). The dashboard uses the actual file count, 46, and labels the report phase separately.

knownCaveats.title: Calibration is fit on the early-stopping split, not the test set
knownCaveats.detail: `phase8_calibration_temp.csv` reports temperature scaling on a held-out calibration slice. Its very small ECE values should not be presented as test-set calibration evidence.

knownCaveats.title: Speed table excludes 1,043 rows with no prior location
knownCaveats.detail: `phase7_speed_rate_table.csv` covers 1,851,351 of 1,852,394 transactions (9,560 of 9,651 frauds). The 38,005 count above 1,000 km/h and its 2.05% share are over all transactions, not over the non-missing-speed subset.

knownCaveats.title: `fp_cost` in the threshold table is total cost, not per-FP cost
knownCaveats.detail: The column equals FP count × $5 (e.g., 20,322 × 5 = 101,610). Total loss is `fp_cost + missed_usd`. The app labels it as total review cost to avoid a unit error.

knownCaveats.title: The learning-curve endpoint differs from the final model
knownCaveats.detail: The full-fraction learning-curve point has PR-AUC 0.5254, while the final model reports 0.5575. They are different training protocols (learning-curve subsamples / fixed parameters), so the curve should not be read as the final model's score.
